current_focus.domain: a clerk turns Manage stock on or off on a product
current_focus.summary: Products page same Save as Regular and Sale: clerk checks or unchecks Manage stock. New products default off. On hides In stock/Out of stock/On backorder and persists setup-required with no auto Configure Inventory, no quantity, no install popup. Off restores dormant stock status, drops the Commerce setup claim, does not contact Inventory, and leaves pool quantity (the 6 red hats) in place. Later enable is not already-claimed; existing SKU is needs-review confirm; title does not remap. Toggle does not rewrite Regular or Sale. A refused Manage stock write leaves prices unchanged. Out: Allow backorders admin, Configure Inventory walk, marketplace install, auto-link, title remap, live quantity on this page. Proof: bin/verify-commerce full plus Products admin check/uncheck/recheck with prices unchanged.
